title: Advisory authority logs the finding; enforcing blocks it again
goal: Before {{castKey}} is allowed to block anything, {{castOwner}} wants to watch the inspector on live traffic while {{castApp}} is {{castTask}}.
obstacle: Turning an inspector on in enforcing mode straight away could block legitimate traffic nobody has seen yet.
control: The authority cap holds the inspector advisory: the same finding is written to the gateway log and the call goes through. Switching the key back to enforcing blocks the very same prompt.
